text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Zoo Board of Management.

City Council on July 23 and 24, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Edward McDonnell to the Toronto Zoo Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on July 21, 2027, and until a successor is appointed. 2. City Council appoint Nora Boyer to the Toronto Zoo Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office starting on November 11, 2025, ending on November 11, 2029, and until a successor is appointed, to succeed Matthew Cole whose term ends on November 10, 2025. 3. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (July 7, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Zoo Board.
